comment: EL-006 S2 rights allowlist. Fail-closed: a dataset not listed here, or listed as not_granted or blocked_pending_operator, is refused. blocked_pending_operator keeps the licence-permitted uses/scopes on record but the gate refuses until the operator's decision changes this entry (a reviewed source change). Adding or changing an entry is a reviewed source change (the operator approves additions) and must update ALLOWLIST_SHA256 in socialcue/data/rights.py. Licence facts are from receipts/EL-006-socialcue/research/licences-and-sources.md (accessed 2026-10-20); not legal advice.

datasets.name: synthetic
datasets.licence_ref: socialcue/synthetic.py: manufactured numbers, no third-party rights involved
datasets.note: The only entry that runs without a further grant.

datasets.name: ravdess
datasets.licence_ref: https://zenodo.org/records/1188976 (accessed 2026-10-20; the page also contains a plain-Attribution mention, NC-SA treated as governing)
datasets.note: Non-commercial research only. Commercial training is not allowed. Whether derived models inherit NC-SA is unknown. The adapter is a declaration that stays blocked until an operator rights/scope decision.

datasets.name: crema_d
datasets.note: Commercial use of the clips (actor releases, share-alike for trained models) is unknown, so it is not listed. The README asks users to fill in a form. The adapter is a declaration that stays blocked until an operator rights/scope decision.

datasets.name: casme2
datasets.licence_ref: licence agreement with the authors required; terms not read
datasets.note: By application. The operator submits; agents never do.

datasets.name: samm
datasets.licence_ref: request process and terms not found
datasets.note: By application. The operator submits; agents never do.

datasets.name: smic
datasets.licence_ref: contact the University of Oulu group; terms not found
datasets.note: By application. The operator submits; agents never do.

datasets.name: pilot_consented
datasets.licence_tag: consented-pilot (terms set by the pilot consent form)
datasets.licence_ref: S9pilot/pilot-protocol.md: consented adult volunteers, mock tasks; no data exists yet
datasets.reason: blocked: needs operator rights/scope decision and an ethics approval
datasets.note: The gate requires the adapter to carry a non-empty ethics_approval_token string. Presence of that string is NOT an approval: nobody verifies it here. The operator and the ethics body decide; the allowlist stays blocked until the operator changes this entry in a reviewed source change.

datasets.name: synthetic_commercial_clean
datasets.licence_ref: socialcue/data/synthetic_commercial_adapter.py: manufactured numbers only; EL-006.S50 synthetic swap demonstration
datasets.note: Explicit reviewed synthetic entry under EL-006.S50; no real commercial-clean dataset or product training authorization.
